name: Nekoyashiki Tora
source:
The protagonist. A first-year student.

He was a genius novelist in his thirties, but was turned young again by his younger sister's medicine. After that, his sister arranged for him to attend the academy as a first-year student.

He had always feared the outside world, but that fear somewhat subsided after he turned young again. That said, he still doesn't have the courage to actively engage with people.

True to his genius novelist roots, he possesses vast general knowledge. Despite the generational gap, he gradually gains acceptance from those around him. His creative talent is recognized by Ruka, leading him to join the Film Club. He puts his weightlifting hobby to use carrying equipment, and also begins acting as a performer.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/recrankin/]official website[/url]]
